findings.claim: A transient initialization failure permanently blocks retry because the failed service remains stored and initialize returns early whenever service is non-null.
findings.evidence: The initialize guard returns on any existing service (`if (get().service || get().phase === "booting") return;`), but the catch path only sets `{ phase: "error", error: ... }` and does not clear `service`, so a failed `service.initialize()` leaves the store unable to retry.
findings.suggested_fix: In the initialize catch block, dispose the partially-created service if needed and set `service: null` so a subsequent initialize call can retry.
